text:
Michael Amadio has points in four straight games and six goals in 19, including the winner in Buffalo. Graeme Nichols of Coming Down the Pipe wrote that Amadio feels like he should have 10 or more already, and TSN's headline had Amadio saying he's been fortunate to get chances and capitalise. His goals have mattered: his wins-added total ranks 54th of 515 skaters.

The caveat is the shooting. Six goals on 24 shots is 25%, far above his usual range around 15%, and his own expected goals (4.3) say he is scoring more than his looks deserve, not fewer. The pace will come down.

What he brings beyond goals is real. Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.7 wins above replacement last season, 73rd among forwards, with strong chance suppression (93rd percentile), though they note he plays with strong teammates. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 57% of his shots coming off the rush.

The Sens Nation podcast is already asking about his next contract. He plays 16 minutes a night in Ottawa's middle six, and that role does not depend on the shooting.
headline: Amadio's goals are finally matching his chances, and then some
